senses.gloss: उत्थ [uttha], a. [उद्-स्था-क] (Used only at the end of comp.)
Born or produced from, arising, springing up, or originating from; दरीमुखोत्थेन समीरणेन Ku.1.8; भवत्संभा- वनोत्थाय परितोषाय मूर्च्छते 6.59; R.12.82; आनन्दोत्थं नयनसलिलम् Me.v.1; Pt.1.274.
Standing up, coming up or forth. -त्थः Arising, coming forth.
To get up, stand, rise, raise oneself; उत्तिष्ठेत्प्रथमं चास्य Ms.2.194; R.9.59; Śi.9.39.
To get up from, leave, give up or cease from; अनाशनादुत्तिष्ठति Pt.4.
To rise, come up (as the sun &c.).
To rebound (as a ball); कराभिघातोत्थितकन्दुकेयम् R.16.83,

To come forth, arise, spring or originate from, accrue from; ग्रामाच्छतमुत्तिष्ठति Mbh; यदुत्तिष्ठति वर्णेभ्यो नृपाणां क्षयि तत्फलम् Ś.2.14; अन्यदमृतादुत्थितम् K.136; उदतिष्ठन् प्रशंसावाचः Dk.49 shouts of applause burst forth (were heard); असंशयं सागरभागुदस्थात् N.22.44.
To rise, increase in strength or power, grow, (as an enemy, disease &c.); (Ātm.) उत्तिष्ठमानस्तु परो नोपेक्ष्यः पथ्यमिच्छता Śi.2.1 (= Pt.1.234.)
To become animated, rise (from the dead) मृतोत्थिता; Ku.7.4.
To be active or brave, rise up; हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ Bg.2.3,37; Mv.2; Pt.3.21.
To make efforts; take pains, strive, try; उत्तिष्ठमानं मित्रार्थे कस्त्वां न बहु मन्यते Bk.8.12; 2.18; Mv.4.6; मुक्तावुत्तिष्ठते जनः Ki.11.13; उदस्थित ऋतौ Śi.14.17.
To cause to stand up, raise, lift up; उत्थाप्यते ग्रावा H.3.35; R.14.59; raise or throw up (as dust); R.7.39.
To instigate, excite, rouse to action; त्वामुत्थापयति द्वयम् Śi.2.57,12; Kām.5.4; H.3.85; Dk.17.
To arouse, awaken, raise to life, make alive; प्राणो हीदं सर्वमुत्थापयति Śat. Br.
To support, feed, aid; अत्र परिकरोत्थापितो$र्थान्तरन्यासालङ्कारः Malli. on Ki.8.4.
One who rises or gets up; निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थम् Bg.18.39; यदा बली भवत्यथोत्थाता भवति Ch. Up.7.8.1.
उत्थान [utthāna], a. Causing to arise or spring up.
नम् 1 The act of rising or standing up, getting up; शनैर्यष्टयुत्थानम् Bh.3.9.
Rising (as of luminaries); इन्दुं नवोत्थानमि- वेन्दुमत्यै R.6.31 newly risen.

(a) Effort, exertion, activity; मेदच्छेद- कृशोदरं लघु भवत्युत्थानयोग्यं वपुः Ś.2.5; ˚शीलः Dk.153 disposed to work; Mv.6.23; यद्युत्थानं भवेत्सह Ms.9.215, effort (for money), acquisition of property. (b) Manly exertion, manhood, Mb.1.2.6; राज्ञो हि व्रतमुत्थानम् Kau. A.1.19. also अर्थस्य मूलमुत्थानम्
Energy. उत्थानेन सदा पुत्र प्रयतेथा युधिष्ठिर । न हयुत्थानमृते दैवं राज्ञामर्थं प्रसाधयेत् ॥ Mb.12.56.14.
A shed where sacrifices are offered.
Business (cares &c.) of a family or realm.

Readiness of the army for fight; युद्धानुकूलव्यापार उत्थानमिति कीर्तितम् Śukra.1.325. -Comp. -एकादशी the eleventh day in the light fortnight of Kārttika when Viṣṇu rises from his four month's sleep (also called प्रबोधिनी) -वीरः A man of action, one who makes effort; Mb. -शीलिन्a. Industrious; Mb.2.
Raising up, causing to get up.
उत्थापनम् [utthāpanam], 1 Causing to rise, come up, or get up.
(In Math.) Finding the quantity sought, an answer to the question, substitution of a value (Colebr.). -नी The concluding verse (ऋच्).
(In math.) To be brought out by substitution; Big.45.
Rising (fig. also); coming forth, becoming visible; चन्द्रगुप्तसहोत्थायिनाम् Mu.3; Pt.3.153.
Risen or rising (as from a seat); वचो निशम्योत्थितमुत्थितः सन् R.2.61,7.1,3.61; Ku.7.61; बिल्वोत्थितां भूमिमिवोरगाणाम् Śi.1.15.
Raised, gone up; पांशुः Śi.5.11; R.6.33; Śi.4.1,17.7.
Born, produced, sprung up, arisen; वचः R.2.61,12.49; broken out (as fire); अग्निः Ratn.4.14; हृदये$ग्निरिवोत्थितः R.4.2. burst into a flame.
Bounded up, rebounded; पतिता उत्थिता Mu.1.
An epithet of a Pragātha consisting of ten Pādas. -तम् Rising, arising; शुनं नो अस्तु चरितमुत्थितं च Av.3.15.4. -Comp. -अङ्गुलिः the palm of the hand with the fingers extended.
